title: Makita HR2630 Rotary Hammer Drill, 26mm, 800W Corded SDS-Plus Hammer Drill Machine, 3-Mode Operation, Variable Speed, Forward & Reverse for Concrete, Wood & Metal
rating: 4.34.3 out of 5 stars(35)4.3 out of 5 stars
description: POWERFUL 800W MOTOR – Delivers up to 2.4J impact energy for fast and efficient drilling and chiseling in concrete, masonry, wood, and metal. 3-MODE OPERATION – Switch easily between rotation only, hammer drilling, and hammer with chiseling for versatile job site applications. 26MM DRILLING CAPACITY – Maximum drilling capacity of 26mm in concrete, 13mm in steel, and 32mm in wood for professional and DIY use. VARIABLE SPEED & REVERSE FUNCTION – Features 0–1200 RPM variable speed trigger with 0–4600 BPM impact rate and forward/reverse rotation for better control. WHAT’S IN THE BOX & WARRANTY – Includes 1 x Makita HR2630 Rotary Hammer Drill, 1 x Side Handle, 1 x Depth Gauge, and 1 x Carry Case. Comes with a 1-year warranty.
